DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。旅行に向けたご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Would you like advice for a trip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の店でこのカードを使いたいです。普段は現金を出す時に使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金出金に使うカードを海外店舗の支払いにも使いたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use this card at shops overseas. I usually use it to withdraw cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to use a card you use for cash withdrawals to pay in overseas shops too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのカードは当行のキャッシュカードです。この商品の海外での買物決済について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is our bank's cash card. I will check whether this product can be used for purchases overseas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の買物用カードと同じ使い方だと思っていました。買物用は家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: キャッシュカードを別の買物用カードと同じと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it worked the same way as my separate shopping card. The shopping card is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the cash card worked the same way as your separate shopping card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品の案内では海外の買物決済に対応していません。別のカードは発行元へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this product's information, it does not support overseas shopping payments. Please check the other card with its issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、このカードを支払い用にはしません。買物用のカードの会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: このカードを買物用にせず別カードの発行元へ照会すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not use this card for payments. I will contact the company that issued my shopping card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not use this card for shopping and will inquire with the issuer of the other card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードの商品名と渡航先、期間を伝えると確認しやすいですね。ここでは別会社の利用条件は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Giving the card's product name, destination country, and travel period will help them check. We cannot determine another company's conditions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来月一週間です。利用可否だけでなく、手数料や制限の確認先も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一週間の渡航予定を示し利用可否と手数料と制限の確認先を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am going for one week next month. Besides whether I can use it, I will also ask where to check fees and restrictions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your one-week travel plans and say you will ask where to check usability, fees, and restrictions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正式な会員向けの問い合わせ先をご利用ください。番号や暗証番号を周囲に見せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the official inquiry contact for cardholders. Do not show the numbers or PIN to people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 国内で現金を出すカードと買物用を分けます。発行元で条件を確認してから旅行の支払方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二種類のカードを区別して発行元の条件確認後に旅行の支払方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish the card for domestic cash withdrawals from the shopping card. I will decide how to pay during my trip after checking the conditions with the issuer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish the two cards and decide your travel payment method after checking the issuer's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご相談ありがとうございます。安全に情報を確認し、ご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for consulting us. Please check the information securely as you prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Would you like to ask about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った保存容器のふたが閉まりません。壊れているので交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容器のふたが閉まらず破損と考えて交換を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lid on the storage container I bought yesterday will not close. It is broken, so can I exchange it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the container lid will not close and you think it is broken, and ask about exchanging it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体とふたを見せてください。セットで買いましたか、それぞれ選びましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the container and lid. Did you buy them as a set or choose them separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別々に選びました。同じ色だったので同じサイズと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本体とふたを別々に色だけで選んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I chose them separately. They were the same color, so I thought they were the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you chose the container and lid separately based only on color.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号を見るとサイズが違います。破損とはまだ確認していません。使用はされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Their numbers show they are different sizes. We have not confirmed any damage yet. Have you used them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 食べ物は入れていません。ふたが合うか一度試しただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食品未使用で合うか試しただけと状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not put food in it. I only tried once to see whether the lid fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese their condition: you have not used them for food and only tried fitting the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入明細を確認して、対応できる内容を担当が判断します。レシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the purchase details and determine what we can offer. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。本体は残して、合うふたを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートを提示し本体を残して適合ふたを探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I would like to keep the container and find a lid that fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain in Japanese that you want to keep the container and find a compatible lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本体の番号を基に合う商品を確認します。今のふたの返品可否は別にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check compatible products using the container's number. We will explain separately whether the current lid can be returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本体はそのまま使う予定です。合うふたと、買ったふたを返せるかを分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 適合品探しと購入済みふたの返品可否を別に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I plan to use the container as it is. Please check a fitting lid separately from whether I can return the lid I bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for finding a compatible product and checking the purchased lid's return eligibility to be handled separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。本体とふたをこの台へ置いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge. Please put the container and lid on this counter and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鳥の写真を撮りたいです。持ってきたパンを少しまけば近くへ来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鳥を撮るため持参パンをまいて呼び寄せられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to photograph birds. Will they come closer if I scatter a little of the bread I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can scatter bread you brought to attract birds for photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の掲示では餌やりは禁止です。鳥を呼ぶためにもまかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The notice in this situation prohibits feeding. Please do not scatter food even to attract birds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の昼食のパンなので、少しならいいと思いました。まだ何もまいていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少量の昼食パンならよいと思ったがまだまいていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is bread from my own lunch, so I thought a little would be fine. I have not scattered any yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought a small amount of your lunch bread would be fine but have not scattered any yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未使用なら袋へしまってください。観察は園路から、鳥へ近付かずできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you have not used it, please put it away in its bag. You can observe from the park path without approaching the birds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンはしまいます。池の縁へ降りず、園路で待って撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンをしまい池縁へ降りず園路から撮影したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put the bread away. I would like to wait and take photos on the path without going down to the pond's edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will put the bread away and want to photograph from the path without going down to the pond's edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その位置をご利用ください。来ない場合に餌で誘うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use that position. If the birds do not come, you cannot lure them with food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来なければ今日は景色を撮ります。鳥の声を携帯で流して呼ぶのも避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鳥が来ない場合は景色を撮り録音の鳥声で呼ぶことも避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they do not come, I will photograph the scenery today. I will also avoid playing bird calls on my phone to attract them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that if the birds do not come, you will photograph the scenery and also avoid attracting them with recorded bird calls.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鳥を呼び寄せず、いる姿を静かに観察してください。三脚を使うなら通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please quietly observe the birds where they are rather than drawing them toward you. If you use a tripod, keep the path clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手持ちで撮ります。パンも音も使わず、園路から鳥が見える範囲だけ観察します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手持ち撮影で餌も音も使わず園路から静かに観察すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take photos handheld. I will use neither bread nor sounds and observe only the birds visible from the park path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will photograph handheld and quietly observe from the path without food or sounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。ほかの利用者にも配慮してお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy yourself while considering other visitors too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行き先のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like advice about your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と日帰りで出かけます。帰りの最終列車に二人で乗れば大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で日帰りし帰りの最終列車に乗ればよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going on a day trip with a friend. Will we be all right if we both take the last train back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether taking the last train back together is sufficient for two people on a day trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人は同じ駅まで帰りますか。友人の方に乗換はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both of you returning to the same station? Does your friend need to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はここまでですが、友人はここから別の線へ乗り換えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人は当駅までだが友人は別路線へ乗換があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am coming back here, but my friend needs to change to another line from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you return to this station, but your friend has a transfer to another line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では乗換先の最終も確認が必要です。こちらの最終が着いてからでは接続しない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you need to check the last service on the connecting line too. Arriving on this line's last train may not allow a connection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ帰る駅を聞きます。私の最終だけで予定を決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の帰着駅を聞き本人の最終だけで予定を決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my friend which station they are returning to. I will not base our plans only on my last train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will ask your friend's final station and not decide plans based only on your own last train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できましたら二人の帰路を照合しましょう。先に券を買うのは待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have checked, let us compare both return routes. Will you wait before buying tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。友人の駅が分かりました。この駅へ帰れる接続を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入を保留し友人の駅までの接続確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will wait. I have found out my friend's station. Please check a connection that gets them back to this station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will hold off on buying and ask for a connection to your friend's station to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では、こちらの最終より一便早い列車で接続する候補があります。両方の行き先を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this situation, there is a possible connection using a train one service before this line's last train. Please check both destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 早い便で二人とも帰れる予定にします。現地を出る時刻もその便に合わせて友人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終より早い接続便で二人の帰路を決め現地出発時刻も友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will plan to take the earlier service so both of us can get home. I will also tell my friend when we need to leave our destination to catch it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will arrange both return routes on an earlier connecting service than the last train and tell your friend the local departure time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では往路も含めて確認します。予定が決まってから購入へ進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the outward journey too. Let us proceed with buying after the plans are settled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。通知についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about a notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 平日は仕事で来られません。必要書類を写真にしてメールで送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 平日に来庁できないため必要書類の写真をメール提出できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot come on weekdays because of work. Can I email photos of the required documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can submit photos of the required documents by email because you cannot visit the office on weekdays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知に提出方法は書かれていますか。原本が必要な項目も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the notice state how to submit them? Let us also check which items require originals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書類を提出とだけあり、メール可とは書かれていません。写真なら同じだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内にメール可の記載はなく写真と書類を同じだと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only says to submit documents and does not say email is allowed. I thought photos would be the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the instructions do not say email is permitted and you thought photos were equivalent to documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真と原本を同じ受付とは扱えません。担当へ使える提出方法を照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot treat photos and originals as the same submission. I will ask the person in charge which submission methods are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 郵送できるならそうしたいです。送る前に原本かコピーかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵送を希望し各書類が原本かコピーか発送前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would prefer to mail them if I can. Please tell me whether each document needs to be an original or copy before I send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you prefer mailing and want to check before sending whether each document should be an original or copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の対象書類ごとに担当が確認します。期限までどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check each document covered by the notice. How long is it until the deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の水曜です。会社を休めるかも確認中ですが、今は郵送が第一希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌週水曜の期限と休暇未定を伝え郵送を第一希望にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next Wednesday. I am also checking whether I can take time off work, but for now mailing is my first choice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State in Japanese the deadline next Wednesday and that leave is undecided, and choose mailing as your first preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出方法と期限の扱いを担当へ確認します。回答前には写真送信も発送も待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the submission method and how the deadline applies with the person in charge. Please wait before sending either photos or mail until there is a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 郵送の可否と必要な書類の形式を先に聞きます。返答を受けてから送る準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 郵送可否と書類形式の担当回答後に発送準備をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask whether mailing is allowed and what form the documents must take. I will prepare to send them after receiving the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will prepare the mailing after the person in charge answers about whether it is allowed and the document format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知の番号で担当へおつなぎします。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will use the notice's number to connect you with the person in charge. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。初めての受診でお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with your first visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紹介元から封筒をもらいました。私の症状メモも中へ入れてから渡せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介封筒へ自分の症状メモを追加して渡すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The referring clinic gave me an envelope. Should I put my own symptom notes inside before handing it over?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to add your symptom notes inside the referral envelope before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒はまだ閉じたままですか。別のメモとして受付へ示していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the envelope still sealed? You can show reception the notes separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封はしてあります。予約メモと症状のメモは自分で書いて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紹介封筒は未開封で予約と症状の自作メモは別にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is sealed. I wrote and brought separate appointment notes and symptom notes myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the referral envelope is unopened and you have separate self-written notes about the appointment and symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒と二つのメモを分けて確認します。予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the envelope and the two notes separately. Please give the name on your appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この予約名です。紹介元へ行った後で、痛む場所が少し変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約名を示し紹介元受診後に痛む場所が変わったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the appointment name. After visiting the referring clinic, the location of the pain changed a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the appointment name and explain in Japanese that the location of your pain changed after the referring clinic visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変化した点は医療職へ伝えます。症状メモにも書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell a medical professional about the change. Is it also written in your symptom notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日までのことしか書いていません。今日の変化は今から追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状メモは昨日までなので今日の変化を追記したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only wrote what happened up to yesterday. I would like to add today's change now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the symptom notes only cover up to yesterday and you want to add today's change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身のメモへ追記してください。詳しい確認は医療職が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please add it to your own notes. A medical professional will check the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分のメモに今日の変化を書きます。封筒は開けず、変化した点も口頭で担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自作メモへ追記し封筒は未開封で提出して変化を口頭でも医療職へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write today's change in my own notes. I will not open the envelope and will also tell the person in charge verbally what has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will add to your own notes, submit the envelope unopened, and verbally tell a medical professional about the change too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を確認し担当へつなぎます。変化があれば待機中もお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the documents and connect you with the person in charge. Please let us know even while waiting if anything changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お困りのことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Please tell me what is troubling you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰り道で同じ方向に歩く人がいて不安になりました。ここで相談してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同方向に歩く人で不安になったため交番で相談したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On my way home, someone was walking in the same direction and I became worried. May I ask for advice here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a person walking in the same direction made you worried and you would like advice at the police box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで伺います。今その方を見ていますか。最後に見た場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will listen here. Can you see the person now? Please tell me where you last saw them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は見えません。二つ前の角まで同じ方向でしたが、その先は振り返っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在は相手が見えず最後に見た角以降は振返っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I cannot see them now. They were going the same direction until the corner two turns back, but I have not looked behind me since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you cannot see the person now and have not looked back since the corner where you last saw them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た区間と見ていない区間を分けて伺います。どのような行動が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask separately about the stretch you saw and the stretch you did not see. What behavior concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が止まった時、少し離れた所でその人も止まりました。目的は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が止まった時相手も離れて止まったが目的は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I stopped, that person also stopped a little distance away. I do not know their purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that when you stopped, the person also stopped some distance away, but their purpose is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その行動として記録します。追跡や目的はまだ確認できません。ご帰宅の方法も一緒に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that behavior. We cannot yet confirm that they were following you or what their purpose was. Let us discuss how you will get home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で急いで帰らず、家族に連絡したいです。自宅の住所はここで職員にだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で急いで帰らず家族へ連絡し住所は職員へ個別に伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to contact my family instead of hurrying home alone. I will give my home address only to the staff here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to contact your family rather than rush home alone and to give your address privately to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個別に伺います。家族への連絡と帰る方法を確認するまで、この席でお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask privately. You can wait in this seat while we confirm contact with your family and how you will get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見た行動だけ説明し、家族へ連絡します。まだ帰らず、職員と帰る方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察した行動だけ説明して家族へ連絡し職員と帰宅方法を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe only the behavior I saw and contact my family. I will stay here for now and discuss with staff how to get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will describe only observed behavior, contact your family, and discuss how to get home with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご相談の内容を順に伺います。こちらのお席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will hear the details in order. Please take this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お手続きでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you having trouble with a procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転居日と転送を始めたい日が同じ欄だと思い、来週の日付を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居日と転送希望日を同一と思い家具搬入日を書いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the moving date and the date I want mail forwarding to start were the same field, so I wrote a date next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the moving date and desired forwarding date were the same and entered the furniture delivery date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来週には新住所で生活を始めるのですか。それとも荷物を運ぶ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you start living at the new address next week, or are you planning to move your belongings then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週は家具だけ運びます。実際に住むのは翌月の一日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家具を運ぶ来週と実際に住み始める翌月一日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am only moving furniture next week. I will actually start living there on the first of next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese next week's furniture move from actually starting to live there on the first of the next month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の転居と郵便の希望日は分けて確認しましょう。来週から転送したい理由はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the actual moving date separately from your preferred mail date. Is there a reason you want forwarding from next week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家具を届ける日から郵便も届くと思いました。でも新居の郵便受けを毎日見られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家具搬入から郵便も届くと思ったが新居の郵便受けを毎日見られないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought mail would arrive from the day the furniture was delivered too. But I cannot check the mailbox at the new place every day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought mail would arrive from the furniture delivery date but cannot check the new mailbox daily.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け取れる状況も考えて希望を確認しましょう。旧住所はいつまで利用できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us consider whether you can receive mail when checking your preference. Until when can you use the old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月末まで住みます。翌月から新居で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月末までは旧住所に住み翌月から新居で受取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will live there until the end of this month. I would like to receive mail at the new place from next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will live at the old address until the end of the month and want to receive mail at the new place from the next month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では実際の転居日と希望を担当へ伝えてください。開始時期は受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then tell the person in charge your actual moving date and preference. We will check the starting date as part of processing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家具の搬入日は来週、生活開始は翌月一日と区別します。翌月からの転送について相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 搬入日と生活開始日を分け翌月からの転送開始を担当へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish furniture delivery next week from starting to live there on the first of next month. I will ask about forwarding from next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will separate the furniture delivery and start-of-living dates and consult the person in charge about starting forwarding next month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。開始が確定するまでは案内を確認してください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the person in charge. Please check the instructions until the starting date is confirmed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご用件を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Please tell me what brings you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話番号を変えましたが、認証の表示は古い番号です。もう新番号へコードが届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話番号変更後も認証先が旧番号で新番号にコードが届くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my phone number, but the verification display still shows my old one. Will codes already arrive at the new number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether codes will arrive at the new number when the verification destination still shows the old number after a phone number change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更完了の画面や控えはありますか。今の表示も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a completion screen or record of the change? Please show the current display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 変更の入力はしました。完了は確認していませんが、旧番号は明日解約する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更入力だけで完了未確認だが旧回線を翌日解約予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered the change. I have not checked completion, but I plan to cancel the old number tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only entered the change and have not confirmed completion, but plan to cancel the old line the next day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力だけで反映済みとは確認できません。認証先の状態を担当へ照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Entering it alone does not confirm the update has taken effect. Let us ask the person in charge about the verification destination's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 解約前に確認したいです。旧番号で受ける携帯もまだ持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解約前の照会を希望し旧番号の携帯もまだ使えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to check before canceling. I still have the phone that receives calls at the old number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want an inquiry before cancellation and that the old-number phone is still usable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方使える状態なのですね。コードそのものは職員へ伝えず、ご自身で扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: So both are still usable. Please handle the code yourself without telling staff the code itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: コードは見せません。旧番号と新番号の表示だけを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 認証コードは共有せず両番号の表示だけ示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not show the code. I will show only the displays of the old and new numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not share the verification code and will show only the displays of the two numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人を確認して変更受付と認証先を調べます。状態が分かるまでは繰り返し変更を送らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will verify your identity and check the number-change submission and verification destination. Please do not submit repeated changes until we know the status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更を送り直さず、解約予定も担当へ伝えます。認証先を確認してから旧回線の予定を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再申請をせず担当照会後に旧回線の解約予定を見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not resubmit the change and will tell the person in charge about my cancellation plans too. I will reconsider the old line's schedule after checking the verification destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not reapply and will reconsider cancellation of the old line after the person in charge's inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。端末はお手元にお持ちください。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge. Please keep the devices with you. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品で何か確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Would you like to check something about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一個五百グラムだと思っていたのですが、この袋には何個入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示の五百グラムを一個の重量と思い袋の個数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought each piece weighed five hundred grams. How many pieces are in this bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how many pieces are in the bag, explaining that you thought the five-hundred-gram label meant one piece's weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 五百グラムは袋全体の内容量です。個数はこちらに十個とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Five hundred grams is the total contents of the bag. The number of pieces is shown here as ten.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十個で五百グラムなのですね。一個分だと思い、四袋をかごに入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十個合計の重さと理解し誤解から四袋選んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So ten pieces weigh five hundred grams. I thought that was for one piece and put four bags in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you now understand it is the total weight of ten pieces and selected four bags because of your misunderstanding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 四袋だと四十個になります。何回分の食事に使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Four bags would be forty pieces. How many meals do you plan to use them for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で一人三個ずつ、一回分です。冷凍庫にも一袋分しか空いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人が三個ずつ一回食べ冷凍庫の空きは一袋分と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One meal for two people, three pieces each. There is also only space for one bag in my freezer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that two people will eat three each for one meal and your freezer has room for only one bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一袋なら六個使った後に四個残ります。残りも保管できそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: With one bag, you will have four pieces left after using six. Can you store the remainder too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一袋なら入ります。残りは次の食事で使う予定にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋なら保存でき残り四個を次の食事で使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One bag will fit. I will plan to use the rest at the next meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can store one bag and will use the four remaining pieces at the next meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では不要な三袋は売場へ戻します。選んだ袋の保存表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will return the three unwanted bags to the section. Please check the storage label on the bag you selected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十個入り一袋だけ買います。袋全体の重さと個数を見て、冷凍庫へ入る量にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十個入り一袋を選び総重量と個数と保管余地を確認して買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy just one bag containing ten pieces. I will check the whole bag's weight and piece count and keep the quantity within what my freezer can hold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you choose one bag of ten and will check the total weight, piece count, and storage space before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。不要分はこちらでお戻しします。レジへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will put the unwanted bags back. Please proceed to checkout.
